fields.label: Primary Language
fields.help: Program-wide software language baseline; confirm each software item language separately.

fields.label: Compiler Name
fields.help: Compiler used for the development baseline.

fields.label: Compiler Version
fields.help: Controlled compiler version.

fields.label: Compiler Flags
fields.help: Compiler switches and optimization settings used for reproducible builds.

fields.label: Linker Name
fields.help: Linker and its controlled version.

fields.label: Static Analysis Tool
fields.help: Static analysis tool and version.

fields.label: Static Analysis Ruleset
fields.help: Ruleset explicitly adopted by the program; no MISRA assumption is made.

fields.label: Coverage Tool
fields.help: Tool and version used to measure structural coverage.

fields.label: Requirements Tool
fields.help: Requirements management tool and version.

fields.label: Requirements Tool Type
fields.help: Which kind of requirements management the program uses. DOORS Next or DOORS 9.x keeps the DOORS module, attribute and traceability section in the requirements standards; Other keeps the Word / other-tool outlines and tagging. Leave blank to keep both alternatives. Record the exact tool name and version in Requirements Tool.

fields.label: Configuration Management Tool
fields.help: Configuration management tool and repository baseline.

fields.label: Test Framework
fields.help: Test framework and version.

fields.label: Target Processor
fields.help: Target processor used by the development environment.

fields.label: RTOS / Operating System
fields.help: Operating system or explicit bare-metal arrangement.

fields.label: IDE
fields.help: Integrated development environment and version.

fields.label: HIL Platform
fields.help: Hardware-in-the-loop test platform and configuration.

fields.label: Build System
fields.help: Build automation tool and version.

fields.label: Hardware Item ID
fields.help: Reference the ID of the hardware item being qualified.

fields.label: DO-160 Section
fields.help: DO-160 section number, 4 through 26. Review applicability with the qualification lead.

fields.label: Section Title
fields.help: Name of the environmental section.

fields.label: Tested
fields.help: Yes means testing has been performed; it does not imply successful qualification. Use TBD when unknown.

fields.label: Qualification Category
fields.help: Category claimed by the qualification evidence, not a guessed installation requirement.

fields.label: Test Severity
fields.help: Test level or severity established by the evidence.

fields.label: Restrictions
fields.help: Limitations, exceptions, exclusions or conditions of the evidence.

fields.label: Qualification Evidence Reference
fields.help: Controlled test report or qualification record supporting this row.

fields.label: Hardware Item ID
fields.help: Reference the hardware item receiving this requirement.

fields.label: DO-160 Section
fields.help: Applicable DO-160 section number, 4 through 26.

fields.label: Required Category
fields.help: Category required by the installation or customer specification.

fields.label: Required Severity
fields.help: Required test level or severity from the flow-down source.

fields.label: Source Specification
fields.help: Specification number and revision imposing this requirement.

fields.label: Flow Down Reference
fields.help: Controlled reference allocating the requirement to this item.

fields.label: Disposition
fields.help: Program disposition of the requirement versus available qualification evidence.

fields.label: Disposition Rationale
fields.help: Explain the evidence comparison and any action needed.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Additional qualification assumptions or references.
